projectDescription: V-Extended is a fan-made modpack for Friday Night Funkin' (V-Slice) that adds a dedicated options page with gameplay customization features for both PC and mobile.
keyFeatures: Ghost Tapping — prevents missed inputs from counting as misses
Middlescroll — centers player notes with split opponent notes (PC)
Opponent Notes Opacity — adjustable transparency for opponent side
Strumline Background — optional gray lane background with configurable opacity and padding
Time Bar — song-progress bar with selectable text modes (Song Name, Difficulty, Time Left/Elapsed, None)
Detailed Score Counter — shows score, misses, accuracy, and rank letter
Score Counter Outline — configurable black outline on the score display
Options in Pause Menu — access options without leaving the song
Botplay in Pause — toggle Botplay directly from the pause screen
Alternative Note Input (Mobile) — full-screen four-lane touch input
PC and Mobile variants with separate version tracks
